steps: template filter: only .js/.css/.html/page.js trigger; ai/ data files never do
per-page check: console errors, 1920 shot, long-task stall > 2 s, settle within 10 s, unknown-verb count
report twice: health log + a log line in the editing agent's task.jsonl via append.mjs
prove the four cases, update Server/doc/health.md, commit, card

decision.chose: both locks (health.mjs and health-supervisor.mjs) are keyed by the repo root, so one per tree
decision.alternative: one machine-wide lock (health.mjs's old lock) - rejected because a worktree's watcher would then never start while main's runs, and the proof could not run without stopping main's monitor

decision.chose: the editing agent's task is the newest unlanded task.jsonl under ai/<today> or ai/<yesterday> whose ledger action lines list the changed file; a file inside a task dir belongs to that task first
decision.alternative: walking every task.jsonl in public/ - rejected, too slow per check

proof 2 (break): a throw in public/framework/ai/health/page.js -> '3 console errors, 2 other errors (status, request)', shot; health-guard blocked my next write; restoring it -> '0 console errors' and an ok line. Files: proof/health-log-excerpt.jsonl, proof/restored-shot.png
proof 3 (data): append.mjs line to a task.jsonl -> console 'data only, no check — 1 file', report count unchanged. File: proof/watcher-console.log
proof 4 (one supervisor): two started 4 s apart in the worktree; the second exited code 0; one supervisor + one health.mjs child; MainWindowHandle 0. Killed by its tree pid after.

caveat: the proof's out-of-band say.mjs cards landed in the worktree's board.jsonl; removed exactly those two lines (file now identical to HEAD). The scratch test dir public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/health-proof/ in the worktree is deleted.

caveat for the mastermind: Servex/Pool.js's per-slot TEMP trick and its comment about the machine-wide lock are now unneeded (outside my fence, harmless). Server/readme.md does not link Server/doc/health.md yet (outside my fence).
